title: How to Break Off an Engagement

choices.label: Tambourine bursts through rose window and suspends over dry pool
6 oak pews vanish one-by-one as cobwebs bridge rafters
Lightning fork splits boxed wedding gifts on the altar
Sacramental bread rots; two porcelain teacups crack
Two trails of wet mud footprints walk away out of step
Tambourine drops to tide line and shatters into brass & wood

I2_threshold.rule: All 6 pews vanish and tambourine shatters on shore tideline (q_end >= 0.88).

I4_signature_constraint.constraint: Zero human puppets on stage (puppet_count == 0 across all 768 frames).
